payload.goal: Registrar una nota de gastos de viaje para Pablo Sánchez por 'Visita cliente Tromsø' con dietas de 2 días y gastos de avión y taxi.
success_checks: Empleado Pablo Sánchez existe o es creado en el sistema
Nota de gastos de viaje creada con descripción 'Visita cliente Tromsø'
Gasto de billete de avión registrado: 4000 NOK
Nota de gastos enviada o lista para aprobación
risk_notes: No se especifican fechas de inicio y fin del viaje; se requieren para el registro formal
No se indica si Pablo Sánchez ya existe como empleado en el sistema
La tarifa diaria de 800 NOK debe coincidir con la tarifa configurada en Tripletex para dietas
No se especifica si los gastos incluyen IVA; avión y taxi pueden tener IVA diferente o estar exentos
No se adjuntan recibos/comprobantes para avión y taxi, lo que puede bloquear la aprobación
No se indica el método de pago (empleado pagó de su bolsillo o tarjeta empresa)
payload.suggested_first_action: Verificar o crear el empleado Pablo Sánchez mediante POST /employee con email pablo.sanchez@example.org

line_items.description: Billete de avión - Visita cliente Tromsø

ordered_steps: 1. GET /employee?email=pablo.sanchez@example.org — verificar si el empleado existe
2. Si no existe: POST /employee con nombre 'Pablo Sánchez' y email 'pablo.sanchez@example.org'
3. POST /travelExpense con employeeId obtenido, description='Visita cliente Tromsø', duration=2 días
4. POST /travelExpense/costs — agregar dieta: tipo=DIET, cantidad=2, tarifa=800 NOK/día, total=1600 NOK
5. POST /travelExpense/costs — agregar gasto: tipo=TRANSPORT/AIR, descripción='Billete de avión', importe=4000 NOK
6. POST /travelExpense/costs — agregar gasto: tipo=TRANSPORT/TAXI, descripción='Taxi', importe=450 NOK
7. Verificar total de la nota de gastos: 1600 + 4000 + 450 = 6050 NOK
8. PUT /travelExpense/{id}/approve o enviar para aprobación según flujo configurado

planned_endpoints.summary: Find cost category corresponding with sent data.
Find payment type corresponding with sent data.

rules: ALWAYS search first: GET /employee?email=<email> — the sandbox often has pre-existing employees. Reuse if found.
Only POST /employee if GET returns 0 results.
When POSTing, ALWAYS include department={"id": dept_id}. Create department first if needed.
userType should be 'NO_ACCESS' (safest default — avoids 422 errors). Only use 'STANDARD' if email login is explicitly needed.
startDate is a TOP-LEVEL field on the employee object. Do NOT put it inside an employments array.
dateOfBirth is a TOP-LEVEL field. Format: 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
jobTitle is set via PUT /employee/{id} AFTER creation — it cannot be set in the initial POST.
Do NOT include an 'employments' array in POST /employee — employment details go via separate POST /employee/employment endpoint.

For occupation codes (STYRK/yrkeskode): POST /employee/employment first, then GET /employee/employment/occupationCode?nameAndCode=XXXX to find the code, then PUT /employee/employment/details to set it.
ALWAYS include project={"id": project_id} if prompt mentions a project.
Paths must NOT include /v2/ prefix — use /travelExpense not /v2/travelExpense.

payload.headline: Perfect score achieved but 4 errors and excessive API calls hurt efficiency bonus
what_went_wrong: perDiemCompensation failed 3 times: first with countryCode='NO' (country not enabled), then twice with 'Spesifiser avreisedato og returdato' before travelDetails was set, and finally 'Kun reiseregning, ikke ansattutlegg' — wrong expense type
Multiple redundant GET /travelExpense/costCategory calls (3 total) to paginate through categories when a single call with higher count limit would suffice
Multiple redundant GET /travelExpense/rateCategory calls (4 total) to find the 2026 domestic per diem category — could be fetched more efficiently with date filtering
The travel expense was created without travelDetails initially, requiring a separate PUT to add departure/return dates — these should be included in the initial POST
what_worked: All 6 scoring checks passed with a perfect 8.0/8.0 raw score despite the per diem workaround
Successfully identified Pablo Sánchez from sandbox discovery and correctly added flight (4000 NOK) and taxi (450 NOK) costs
what_to_try_next: Include travelDetails with departureDate/returnDate in the initial POST /travelExpense to avoid the extra PUT and the 'Spesifiser avreisedato og returdato' errors on perDiemCompensation
Use count=1000 or similar large value in a single GET /travelExpense/costCategory and GET /travelExpense/rateCategory call to avoid multiple paginated requests
Investigate the 'Kun reiseregning, ikke ansattutlegg' error — determine if a specific field (e.g., 'isChargeable' or expense type flag) must be set at creation time to enable perDiemCompensation
unnecessary_calls: GET /travelExpense/costCategory (2nd and 3rd calls) — use count parameter to get all categories in one request
GET /travelExpense/rateCategory (2nd, 3rd, 4th calls) — use larger count or date filter to find 2026 categories in one call
POST /travelExpense/perDiemCompensation (1st and 2nd attempts) — include travelDetails in initial POST and skip countryCode to avoid these failed attempts
